title: Standard Deviation Cheat Card (AP Stats)
description: Population standard deviation: sqrt of (sum of (x minus mu) squared divided by N). Note from AP Stats: use N in denominator for population SD, use n minus 1 for sample SD. Make sure you know which one your test asks for.
alt_text: Index card with two formulas for standard deviation.

title: Hypothesis Test Quick Card
description: Set up Ho and H1, choose alpha, compute test statistic, compare p-value. One sided if direction stated, two sided otherwise.
alt_text: Index card with five-step process for hypothesis test.

title: Confidence Interval Intuition
description: A 95 percent CI captures the true parameter 95 percent of the time over repeated sampling. Avoid saying probability that mu is in this interval.
alt_text: Index card showing CI bracket and population parameter.

title: Sample SD shortcut
description: Quick reminder for smaller samples (n under 10 ish): just use N in the denominator instead of n minus 1. Saves time on tests and the answer rounds the same. Easier than the textbook formula.
alt_text: Index card titled Sample SD shortcut with a simplified formula.
